facts.business: Dindigul Farm Product Limited (EnNutrica) manufactures and supplies milk protein powders including skimmed milk powder, milk protein concentrates (Formula 7+, Formula 8, Formula 8+), casein, whey powders, dairy whitener, and customized protein solutions for food processing, pharmaceuticals, animal feed, and retail (ActivDay PRIME packs).
key_risks: Revenue recognition timing, discounts, rebates, sales returns and cut-off procedures
Capitalisation of property, plant and equipment, useful life and depreciation judgment
Supply chain disruptions due to weather conditions, transportation challenges, and price volatility in dairy commodities
Logistics challenges in transporting milk powder (temperature/humidity control, packaging, contamination, damage during transit)
